ov: إطلاق النار على فيل (الإنجليزية: To Shoot an Elephant) هو فيلم وثائقي تم إنتاجه في إسبانيا وصدر في سنة 2009.
plotEn:
To Shoot an Elephant is an "eye witness account" of the Gaza Strip from December 2008 to January 2009 during Operation Cast Lead, otherwise known as the First Gaza War and the Gaza Massacre. Director Alberto Arce was filming in Gaza in late 2008 as a member of the International Solidarity movement. As a result, he was one of the few foreign journalists present inside the strip when the conflict broke out, as Israeli forces banned foreign journalists from entering the area. 
The film is focused on the ambulance personnel in the Gaza Strip during that time period. Specifically, it filmed how medical teams and hospitals were targeted by Israeli forces.
